claims.claim: Protección Civil decreed the maximum alert for 28 municipalities in Jalisco and Colima ahead of category-four Hurricane Simón, and Puerto Vallarta suspended flights until Monday.
claims.episode_span: Protección Civil has decreed the maximum alert for twenty-eight municipalities in Jalisco and Colima
claims.source_title: Jalisco y Colima se preparan para la embestida del huracán ‘Simón’, de categoría cuatro
claims.supporting_quote: Protección Civil decreta el nivel máximo de alerta para 28 municipios de los dos estados. Puerto Vallarta suspende los vuelos hasta el lunes

claims.claim: A decree under Javier Milei offers foreigners naturalization not limited to residence, reported at 350,000 dollars per person with family discounts, and the opposition is trying to stop it in Congress.
claims.episode_span: a new regime approved by decree under Javier Milei offers foreigners naturalization
claims.source_title: Milei vende la ciudadanía argentina a 350.000 dólares por persona y oferta descuentos para familias
claims.supporting_quote: El nuevo régimen aprobado por decreto ofrece naturalización para extranjeros y no se limita a la residencia. La oposición intenta frenarlo en el Congreso

claims.claim: Brazil's Superior Electoral Court gave Meta 48 hours to clarify whether it reduced the reach of Lula campaign posts.
claims.episode_span: Brazil’s Superior Electoral Court gave Meta forty-eight hours to clarify whether it reduced the reach
claims.source_title: Meta faces election interference accusations from Brazil's Lula da Silva; court gives company 48 hours to clarify
claims.supporting_quote: Brazil's Superior Electoral Court (TSE) on Saturday gave Meta 48 hours to clarify whether it reduced the reach of posts by Lula's campaign.

claims.claim: Lula's campaign alleged Meta blocked promotion of Instagram posts, interrupted view counts, and that leftist profiles disappeared from Instagram search before the first round, and said this raised suspicions of interference benefiting Flávio Bolsonaro.
claims.episode_span: the technical issues raise strong suspicions that Meta’s actions were an attempt to interfere
claims.source_title: Meta faces election interference accusations from Brazil's Lula da Silva; court gives company 48 hours to clarify
claims.supporting_quote: The series of technical issues... raises strong suspicions that Meta's actions constitute an attempt to interfere in the Brazilian electoral process to the benefit of Flavio Bolsonaro's candidacy.

claims.claim: The TSE ordered Meta to report profile by profile all measures applied to Lula's official accounts and to explain anomalies in video metrics.
claims.episode_span: report, profile by profile, all measures applied to Lula’s official accounts
claims.source_title: Meta faces election interference accusations from Brazil's Lula da Silva; court gives company 48 hours to clarify
claims.supporting_quote: Meta was ordered to "report, profile by profile, all the measures applied" to "Lula's official accounts" and to "explain the anomalies in the metrics" of the videos, the TSE said.

claims.claim: On day one of the 2026 Sudamericano SAR sevens in Villa Carlos Paz, Argentina's women shut out the Dominican Republic, Guatemala, and Paraguay, and Brazil's men beat Colombia 19-17.
claims.episode_span: Argentina’s women shut out the Dominican Republic, Guatemala, and Paraguay, while Brazil’s men beat Colombia nineteen to seventeen
claims.supporting_quote: The Argentine women notched commanding shutout victories against the Dominican Republic (62-0), Guatemala (69-0), and Paraguay (36-0).

claims.claim: Pope Leo XIV, 71, announced he will enter hospital in the coming days to remove a lung nodule, with arrival in Argentina scheduled for November 8.
claims.episode_span: Pope Leo XIV, seventy-one, said after Sunday’s Angelus that he will enter hospital
claims.source_title: El papa León XIV anunció que se internará para operarse de un nódulo en un pulmón a pocos días del viaje a la Argentina
claims.supporting_quote: el papa León XIV, de 71 años, anunció que en los próximos días se internará en el hospital para operarse y removerse un nódulo en el pulmón

claims.source_title: Barra da Tijuca é o bairro do Rio onde comércio e serviços mais cresceram no pós-pandemia
claims.supporting_quote: Entre 2022 e 2025, a Barra da Tijuca registrou 15.978 aberturas de novos estabelecimentos, mais do que qualquer outro bairro do município.
